# ghost_repository_rulesets (Data Source)

Lists every ruleset on a Ghost repository, whatever its enforcement, with its conditions, bypass actors and rules in the same shape as `ghost_repository_ruleset`. Rulesets are Ghost's only branch and tag protection. To see which existing branches an active ruleset protects, use `ghost_branches`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every ruleset on a repository, whatever its enforcement.
data "ghost_repository_rulesets" "app" {
  repository = "my-org/my-repo"
}

locals {
  rulesets = data.ghost_repository_rulesets.app.rulesets
}

# Rulesets that are enforced, by name.
output "active_rulesets" {
  value = [for rs in local.rulesets : rs.name if rs.enforcement == "active"]
}

# Rulesets that require a pull request, and how many approvals they need.
output "required_approvals" {
  value = {
    for rs in local.rulesets : rs.name => rs.rules.pull_request.required_approving_review_count
    if rs.rules.pull_request != null
  }
}

# The ID to import a ruleset Terraform didn't create, e.g.
# terraform import ghost_repository_ruleset.main "my-org/my-repo:ruleset_…".
output "import_ids" {
  value = { for rs in local.rulesets : rs.name => "${data.ghost_repository_rulesets.app.id}:${rs.ruleset_id}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository's current full name, `owner/slug`. It differs from `repository` when that names a repository that has since been renamed.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `rulesets` (Attributes List) The repository's rulesets, oldest first. Empty when it has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets))

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets`

Read-Only:

- `bypass_actors` (Attributes List) Who may bypass the ruleset. Ghost shows bypass actors only to repository admins, so this is null when the token isn't one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--bypass_actors))
- `conditions` (Attributes) The refs the ruleset applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--conditions))
- `enforcement` (String) `active` enforces the rules, `evaluate` only reports what would be blocked, and `disabled` turns the ruleset off.
- `html_url` (String) The ruleset's page in the web UI. Only repository admins can open it; other users get a 404, even on a public repository.
- `name` (String) The ruleset name, unique within the repository.
- `node_id` (String) The ruleset's GitHub-style node ID.
- `numeric_id` (Number) The ruleset's numeric ID in the GitHub-compatible API and in web UI links.
- `rules` (Attributes) The rules the ruleset enforces. Each flag is `false` and each object null when that rule is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--rules))
- `ruleset_id` (String) Ghost's ID for the ruleset, e.g. `ruleset_tcql3h2wcrh4uqqxfndwsspt`, the same as `ghost_repository_ruleset`'s `ruleset_id`. Import a ruleset with `<id>:<ruleset_id>`.
- `target` (String) What the ruleset protects: `branch` or `tag`.

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--bypass_actors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.bypass_actors`

Read-Only:

- `actor_type` (String) `RepositoryRole`, `Team` or `OrganizationAdmin`.
- `bypass_mode` (String) `always`, or `pull_request` when bypassing is allowed only through a pull request.
- `role` (String) For `RepositoryRole` actors, the role that may bypass: `write`, `maintain` or `admin`. Null otherwise.
- `team_id` (String) For `Team` actors, the team's ID. Null otherwise.


<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `ref_name` (Attributes) Ref name patterns to include and exclude. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--conditions--ref_name))

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--conditions--ref_name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.conditions.ref_name`

Read-Only:

- `exclude` (List of String) Patterns excluded from `include`, in the same form.
- `include` (List of String) Patterns the ruleset applies to, as Ghost stores them: `refs/heads/…` or `refs/tags/…`, or `~DEFAULT_BRANCH` or `~ALL`.



<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.rules`

Read-Only:

- `creation` (Boolean) Only bypass actors may create matching refs.
- `deletion` (Boolean) Only bypass actors may delete matching refs.
- `non_fast_forward` (Boolean) Force pushes are blocked.
- `pull_request` (Attributes) Changes must go through a pull request. Null when this rule is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--rules--pull_request))
- `required_linear_history` (Boolean) Merge commits are blocked.
- `required_signatures` (Boolean) Commits must have verified signatures.
- `required_status_checks` (Attributes) Status checks must pass before merging. Null when this rule is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--rules--required_status_checks))
- `update` (Boolean) Only bypass actors may push to matching refs.

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--rules--pull_request"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.rules.pull_request`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_merge_methods` (Set of String) Merge methods allowed: any of `merge`, `squash` and `rebase`.
- `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push` (Boolean) New commits dismiss earlier approvals.
- `require_code_owner_review` (Boolean) A code owner must approve changes to files they own.
- `require_last_push_approval` (Boolean) Someone other than the last pusher must approve.
- `required_approving_review_count` (Number) Approving reviews needed before merging.
- `required_review_thread_resolution` (Boolean) Every review thread must be resolved before merging.


<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--rules--required_status_checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.rules.required_status_checks`

Read-Only:

- `do_not_enforce_on_create` (Boolean) The checks aren't required when a matching ref is created.
- `required_check` (Attributes List) The status checks that must pass. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rulesets--rules--required_status_checks--required_check))
- `strict_required_status_checks_policy` (Boolean) Branches must be up to date with the base branch before merging.

<a id="nestedatt--rulesets--rules--required_status_checks--required_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rulesets.rules.required_status_checks.required_check`

Read-Only:

- `context` (String) The status check context, e.g. `ci/build`.
